name: Poro-Snax
description:
Active - Consume: Serves a scrumptious scoop to a nearby Poro, causing it to grow in size.

This savory blend of Avarosan hen and Freljordian herbs—now finished with a touch of refined Demacian sugarcraft—contains the essential nutrients necessary to keep your Poro positively radiant.

All proceeds will be donated towards the Cloudfield Youth Choir. Help a Demacian child afford an etwahl, today!
